content:
rishi: FYI perf alert from canary: sudden p95/p99 lift for short chat requests after kernel-selector + batching-heuristic deploy. Affects seq < 48 mostly.

rishi: Trace looks like: kernel.selector.choose -> tokenizer.Vectorize -> batching.Adapt -> preparse.HeaderShrink -> kvcache.Lookup -> grpc.writeSmallFrame -> net.writev.

jessica: pprof slice from the canary run:
```
pprof top
32.8%  tokenizer.Vectorize
21.0%  kernel.selector.Choose
14.5%  batching.Adapt
9.6%   grpc.writeSmallFrame
7.3%   preparse.HeaderShrink
6.0%   kvcache.Lookup
4.8%   net.writev
```

arjun: interesting - tokenizer.Vectorize was a perf win on long sequences but it allocates aligned buffers for small inputs which increases memcpy/grow overhead. batching.Adapt also increased batch-window for short requests causing more prefix miss in kvcache.

nina: repro harness we used: `tools/bench/mini-chat-client --qps 800 --seq-len 32 --clients 200 --duration 60s`

nina: capture steps:
```
# start canary services
./deploy/canary.sh --tag canary-token-vector
# run bench
./mini-chat-client --qps 800 --seq-len 32 --out /tmp/vec-perf
# fetch pprof from runtime
curl http://canary.local:6060/debug/pprof/profile?seconds=30 -o /tmp/vec-perf/pprof.pb
```

arjun: tried toggling batching window: setting `runtime.batching.batch_window_ms=3` (was 12) reduced p99 ~9% and lowered batching.Adapt CPU. But tokenizer.Vectorize still dominates.

rishi: created RED-2087 "short-request tail regression after vectorized tokenizer + batching heuristic" and assigned to eng-runtime, severity P2. perf-bot: ticket RED-2087 created by rishi.

jessica: short-term mitigation options:
- revert tokenizer.Vectorize for seq < 64 (feature-flag conditional)
- special-case small seq in tokenizer to use non-alloc path
- reduce batch_window_ms for small-req route
- enable proxy writev coalescing to collapse grpc small frames

arjun: I prototyped a non-alloc fast path in tokenizer.Vectorize: uses stack scratch for <= 48 tokens and falls back otherwise. Microbench shows ~2.5x lower allocs and improves p99 by ~11% in the harness. Will open PR.

nina: also instrumented kvcache metrics: small-req hitrate dropped ~6% after the batching change (more short batches had different prefix canonicalization). Need to add unit tests for canonicalization in preparse.HeaderShrink.

rishi: PR link (draft): https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1334 (vectorize small-path + tests).

jessica: plan for canary: land small-path PR behind flag, set batch_window_ms=3 for canary, enable writev coalesce in proxy. Run 3 canary runs over next 6 hours and monitor p95/p99 + kvcache hitrate.

arjun: will also add a perf regression test in CI that runs mini-chat-client for seq 32 and fails if p99 increases >5% relative to baseline.

nina: thanks 1f44 will follow up with dashboards and the KV hitrate delta.

rishi: tagging shiproom to review rollback/mitigation if this hits Dedicated customers tomorrow.
